name: discord-oss-official-desktop
description: Instance switcher for the official Discord desktop apps

scripts.build: bun build src/switcher.ts --outfile dist/switcher.js --target node --format cjs --external electron --banner 'var discordOssFolder = __dirname;' && bun build src/preload.ts --outfile dist/preload.js --target node --format cjs --external electron && cp src/switcher.html dist/switcher.html && cp dist/switcher.js dist/switcher-js.txt && cp dist/preload.js dist/preload-js.txt && cp dist/switcher.html dist/switcher-html.txt
scripts.installer: bun run build && bun build src/install.ts --compile --outfile dist/discord-oss-switcher
